name: Illyrian Cycling
description: Performance cycling in Montenegro. Guided camps or self-guided performance blocks, engineered around terrain, load, recovery and progression.

name: Illyrian Cycling Performance Blocks
description: Guided camps or self-guided performance blocks. One methodology, engineered around Montenegro’s terrain, load, recovery and progression.

offers.name: 3 DAY — COAST TO MOUNTAIN
offers.description: A compact introduction to Montenegro’s coast-to-mountain terrain. Three consecutive riding days with no scheduled recovery.

offers.name: 5 DAY — THE PERFORMANCE BLOCK
offers.description: The core Illyrian self-guided block. A complete progression engineered around accumulated load, recovery and a defined peak.

offers.name: 7 DAY — DEEP PROGRESSION
offers.description: A deeper performance progression with additional recovery and terrain variation. Designed for a longer accumulation of load.
